findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 5 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Computer Science Board shape (8 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 12 questions numbered 1-12; by section: 5.2 9, 5.3 3.

Covers the three error types with corrected programs, finding a logic error with pytest, a pytest test file for a grade function, unittest vs pytest and good test cases, finding a bug with breakpoints and watches, a step-by-step debugging trace, a watch-expression trace, the class-activity division program with multiple exception types, the database example (try-except, commit, rollback, finally), profiling and optimization with a nested-loop count, slow_sum vs fast_sum with timeit, and profiling tools and bottlenecks. The exercise's long questions are not repeated. Every program was run in Python 3 (tests with pytest) and its real output is given; timing values are from one run and differ on each computer. Book corrections followed (Figure 5.1 area 15, Figure 5.2 breakpoint on a code line, Figure 5.3 headings); Step Over is described as executing the line, not skipping it.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
